# Copilot Instructions

## Output Style
- Code only, no explanations.
- Prefer bullet points over long paragraphs.
- Keep answers concise (máx. 10 líneas por respuesta).
- Avoid repeating context already visible in the editor.

## Context Management
- Ignore generated files, lockfiles, and dependencies.
- Do not include comments unless explicitly requested.
- Summarize large code blocks instead of expanding them fully.

## Efficiency Rules
- Use short variable names when possible.
- Suggest only one solution at a time.
- Skip boilerplate unless essential.
